mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pocket folds to the veins was most worthwhile: the planned picture connected valve action with limb-muscle compression and blood return.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the thin wall to make veins felt mostly like a predictable assembly step; its result added little explanation by itself.

surprise.text: The venous-return result brought in contracting limb muscle, making clear that the valves prevent backflow while compression helps move blood.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although joining the completed exchange bed to venous return was largely the obvious remaining step.

continue.text: I would continue: the constructions linked vessel structure to function clearly, especially the venous-return mechanism, though I would hope for more explanatory detail in some results.
